reviews_h2: What people are saying about the plumbing

reviews.author: Lisa Morris-McKleny
reviews.text: I contacted Ron with Kings Plumbing for a potential leak. Good thing I did! Ron and his partner discovered a huge leak, and they did a fantastic job fixing it! They listened to my concern, detected the problem swiftly, fixed it, and did a good job tidying up when they were done! I will continue to use Kings Plumbing for any future plumbing needs. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: George Redifer
reviews.text: He was extremely quick in his reply, got to our house and solved our washing machine problems. Very professional service.

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.text: Ron from Kings Plumbing is the best! He fixed 4 issues in my house and was quick, skilled, nice, and attentive to every concern/question I had throughout. Every other plumber I've used in Norfolk has this ridiculous flat rate price book, where they evaluate your job, hide in the van on their iPad forever, then finally return and quote something absurd like $700 to snake a drain. Ron looked at each item and had a fair estimate within seconds. I wish I had discovered Kings Plumbing earlier in my time here, and I would recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Chintana Adams
reviews.text: They were really nice and apologetic but my pipes bursted and they DO NOT OFFER EMERGENCY SERVICES as of rn. It shouldn’t be in the description.

reviews.author: Caroline Weeks
reviews.text: Ron came by today and was absolutely wonderful, professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly helpful! He took the time to outline everything I should consider and prepare before he got started, making the process smooth and stress-free.

reviews.author: Shari Hutchinson
reviews.text: We had such a great experience with Ron and the guys! They figured out exactly what was wrong and knew just what to do. They were all so friendly and respectful. King's Plumbing is definitely now our go-to whenever we need any plumbing work and we can't wait to recommend them to our friends!

reviews.author: Alexandra Hoover
reviews.text: We have now used Kings twice, once for a kitchen sink clog and once to replace a leaking pipe coming off our water heater. The first time, they were the only company that would give me any kind of baseline estimate for clearing the kitchen sink clog. While timing can always be a little flexible with the nature of plumbing, they are always very on top of communication and prompt about arrival time when one has been scheduled and communicated. We have had both Mitch and Ron out to do work, and they were both incredibly friendly and efficient. They're definitely our go to for plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Arron and Emily Achey
reviews.text: I’ve used Ron and Kings Plumbing now multiple times for my rental property for detecting leaks, fixing leaks, fixing toilets, pumping sewage…All good work, prompt as well, when I had two more emergent jobs needed, he made them happen fast. Have really appreciated his insight and advice about various things plumbing as well. Not easy to find plumbers you trust, but I definitely recommend Kings plumbing and sure will be using the services again!

reviews.author: Josh Combs
reviews.text: I own a few rental properties and have dealt with a lot of good contractors, but Kings plumbing has gone above and beyond. How often does a contractor bill LESS than originally quoted? Ron set a reasonable quote at the beginning of the job and promised to work to be under. He did it by a significant amount. Not only that, but he engineered the fix in a way that will most definitely save me time and money in the future. I would have been thrilled with his work without the extra thought. Under budget and way over expectations. Honestly, that NEVER happens when working with contractors... it is just the nature of the business, but I have used Kings multiple times, and they have always been the exception. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Alain Parcan
reviews.text: Had them come out twice in a week for two separate issues and they were terrific both times. Solved both issues, answered all my questions, explained everything in detail. Timely and affordable - I’ll definitely use them again. Bonus points for putting up with my crazy dogs!

reviews.author: Cindy Reppert
reviews.text: Ron & Mike did an excellent job replacing our kitchen faucet. They were on time, professional, polite & friendly. We are definitely keeping their phone number handy for the next time we need plumbing services!

reviews.author: Mark Taylor
reviews.text: If I could King’s Plumbing 10 stars I would. Ron and his team went above and beyond anything I could’ve hoped for, working well into the night to solve my problem. And not only were they extremely professional, they were also personable and friendly. I couldn’t be happier with their services and can’t recommend them enough. They are my plumbers for life!

reviews.author: Glenn B
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about my experience with Kings Plumbing. Ron and Mitch were incredible to work with. Ron was responsive from my initial call and made scheduling my faucet repair very easy. Ron gave me a call before heading toward my home and arrived slightly early. It is clear that they make an intentional effort to respect their client's time and their homes. They wore shoe coverings before entering my home without making me ask them to which I appreciated since we have a light colored carpet upstairs. Ron quickly identified the problem with my faucet and they completed the repair within the hour. Ron communicated exactly what was wrong and how he planned to repair it. They were both extremely professional and personable. They are the only plumbing company I will be using here in Virginia Beach. I strongly recommend them.

reviews.author: Faith Acfalle
reviews.text: Really great experience with Kings Plumbing. Did some research on yelp and they had the best reviews so I felt confident reaching out to them. The reviews did not disappoint… they were very prompt and always answered my phone calls right away. Initially I called on Wednesday and asked for someone to come take a look at my drains for an assessment and they said they were booked until Friday, but surprisingly they ended up coming out that very same day and not only assessed our drains but started working on them right away. They spent an hour on Wednesday trying to snake the drain clean but instead of wasting any time they said the machine they were using was not strong enough for the severity of the blockage and said they would come back Friday with a stronger machine. The following day on Thursday they said they could squeeze me in and wanted to come earlier so that I wouldn’t have to wait until Friday so again, they came earlier than expected and got the issue fixed right away with that stringer machine and my drains were good to go!!! They continued to go above and beyond because even after the issue was fixed they did thorough testing to ensure every pipe in the house was draining correctly. I really valued the attention and care King’s Plumbing put into their work. They were intentional to make sure I knew every step that was taking place for the entire process start to finish. They showed me how to check the drain access from the side of the house which I never even knew about prior, they talked me through the actions being taken and explained everything clearly so I could follow along. When the work was finished they showed me everything was working properly and told me what to avoid for future blockages and warning signs to look out for. They were all friendly and professional and I had a great time talking with them. They are honest hard working men that I would recommend to all my friends and family. Additionally, they were even kind enough to fix my wobbly door knob!!! Not related to the drains at all but they just showed that much care for their clients. Absolutely amazing.

reviews.author: Nicole Lewis
reviews.text: King's Plumbing has been a great experience for me two times now. The company has helped me with problems with a water heater, a leaking water valve, and today's problem with a toilet. They arrived on time and completed the job quickly and professionally. Offer reasonable and fair prices. The staff was friendly and knowledgeable. Additionally, they always explain what had gone wrong and what was being done to fix it. Excelent Company - Ron and his team have exceeded every expectation I had. You deserve 100 stars!! Use King's Plumbing and you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Brandon Williams
reviews.text: Mitch called and came out a day earlier to fix my toilet. He did a fantastic job. He explained and even showed me what the problem was and fixed it same day. No complaints at all. The whole process, from setting up an appointment to the actual work being done was top notch. Price was very reasonable!

reviews.author: Denise Douyon
reviews.text: I've had the pleasure of working with Ron on multiple occasions. Overall just an amazing experience! Ron is a SUPER patient, kind and welcoming person.... makes you feel like family! Highly recommend King's Plumbing!!!

reviews.author: Lynn Marcussen
reviews.text: I have an older home and called them to take a look at a leak. Ron was super flexible with my schedule and gave a reasonable estimate. It was fixed with efficiency and determination as it was a little harder than they estimated. Ron still only charged me within the range that he originally gave me. His crew is friendly, experienced, and real pros at what they do. I would definitely recommend Kings Plumbing for any household plumbing issue.

reviews.author: Lorie Vann
reviews.text: Ron and Mitch arrived and assessed the issue quickly. They explained what was going on and answered our questions. I was pretty stressed about it all but their calm demeanor and explanations put us at ease. They handled the clog very quickly, professionally, and at a reasonable cost. We will be calling Kings Plumbing for our future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Jennifer Miller
reviews.text: Kings Plumbing is the Best! They truly treat you like royalty! Ron and Mitch are so prompt, professional, knowledgeable, friendly, and trustworthy. They did an outstanding job installing my new toilet and fixing two leaks, all at a great price. I highly recommend Kings Plumbing and will only use them in the future. This is an excellent company and they truly deserve five stars!

reviews.author: Shareefah Riddick
reviews.text: I had a clog at my home and Kings Plumbing not only remedied the problem they provided me education on how to prevent it happening in the future. Quite refreshing for someone to tell you how to avoid paying them for the same issue over and over again. They fit me in the very next day and I was goo to go! I’d recommend Kings Plumbing to anyone looking for a professional, responsive and ethical plumbing company.

reviews.author: Dabeon Davis
reviews.text: This is my second time using Kings Plumbing and they’ve been great each time. Highly recommend! Thank you Kings Plumbing!

reviews.author: Sam Johnson
reviews.text: Ron answered my call on Saturday morning and came out to check the water heater. He installed a new one on Sunday morning and there were no extra charges for after hours. He even addressed a couple of additional issues while he was there. He was courteous responsive and efficient. I recommend his service highly.

reviews.author: Oluwatomisin Oredein
reviews.text: King’s Plumbing is the epitome of professional, quality. Ron and Mike were on time, kind, efficient, and even took a look at another plumbing issue and helped resolve it. Book with King’s Plumbing for wonderful service!

reviews.author: Matt Koger
reviews.text: Kings was easy to work with, responsive, accommodating, and offered the best price of any estimate received. The technician was very personable and accomplished the task at hand quickly and efficiently. I'll be giving them a call for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: NikkiGagliardo
reviews.text: Ron and Mitch from Kings plumbing have come by to help us out several times now - for a full water heater replacement, and then later to replace the handle, faucet and drain hardware for both of our bathrooms. They were responsive, professional, and reliable. They showed up on time. They communicated problems quickly and clearly, and were great at setting expectations for turnaround time and cost. When we had minor issues with the work the next day, they prioritized coming back to resolve it, and we've not had further issues since. We referred them to our neighbors who also had a great experience with them. While there isn't much plumbing left in my house that they haven't already touched, if we DO ever need plumbing help - we will certainly be calling them again!

reviews.author: k kaur
reviews.text: 6/2024 - I went to write this review and found I had already left one exactly four years ago. And guess what? When I ran into another major plumbing issue (PB pipe leak) four years later - I called Ron and his team! King's Plumbing has definitely worked for and successfully earned my loyalty! 7/2020 - Had a full Water Heater Replacement done. Ron and his team were professional, on time and knowledgable. Ron went above and beyond the call of duty to show me out to water main and taught me how and under what circumstances I should access it.

reviews.author: Richard Adams
reviews.text: I am a retired Navy Warrant Officer and pretty skeptical of certain home repair and big company skilled trades, so after talking with Ron at Kings Plumbing I decided to hire them for a plumbing issue at my daughter's house. Ron and Mitch were outstanding. My daughter has been having drainage problems with her house which she bought 3 months ago and I searched for a plumber after exhausting all ideas and my capabilities. I called around and no one could show up for at least a week. I called Kings and Ron called me back within 10 minutes. He said that he could be there by 3 or 4 that day. He and his partner Mitch showed up around 4 and commenced to tackle the problem. The house was built in 1956 and the plumbing was not the standard layout. They were extremely professional and very thorough. After a couple of hours of investigation and drainage cleaning my daughter's plumbing was working and draining like a new house. I can't express how much I appreciate the work they did and the price was extremely reasonable. I would highly recommend Kings Plumbing for any and all types of plumbing and water supply issues you may have. Again, thank you Ron and Mitch and Kings Plumbing for taking care of this issue.

reviews.author: Melinda Lowe
reviews.text: I highly recommend this company and will continue to use them for future plumbing needs. They installed a new hot water heater and put on an expansion tank, installed water leak alarm, installed hot/cold water valves and insulation of the pipes. They did a great job! I had received 4 estimates prior and they beat the pricing of all of them. They were punctual, clean, and explained everything thoroughly. Ron has to be the kindest man I’ve ever done business with. Thank you kings plumbing!

reviews.author: Alexandra Hoover
reviews.text: We had a clogged kitchen sink drain, and I called around to several businesses trying to make a decision on who to go with. Ron was the most upfront about a pricing estimate. I understand that specific quotes cannot usually be given until a technician assesses the problem in person, but other companies would not even give me a general idea of where pricing started for the issue we were looking at. Mitch showed up on time and was incredibly friendly, and had the problem fixed in under an hour. The price was exactly what Ron had estimated, with no separate fee just for coming out or extra hourly charges. We will definitely be calling King's for any future plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Susanna Carlson
reviews.text: Ron and Mitch are professional, friendly, considerate and did an excellent job of installing our new faucet, garbage disposal, soap dispenser and disposal button. They also connected the dishwasher to the new sink, all in all great job!

reviews.author: Jen Jackson
reviews.text: Kings Plumbing was very helpful in explaining the problem and what needed to be done to repair it. They were up front about the approximate cost and thorough in checking other issues. Ron clearly communicated the work, the issues, and provided timely updates. I’m very pleased with the service and would definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Stephie Jo
reviews.text: We have had Kings out a few times to take care of our plumbing needs. Ron and the rest of the staff are wonderful. They are professional, friendly, hard working and have done an excellent job with all the work we've needed done. I will always use them for repairs and installation and highly recommend them for any plumbing job needed.

reviews.author: Doris Knight-Bingham
reviews.text: We live in an area with lots of trees. The toilet kept clogging every few months. We've had lots of plumbers come out but the problem persisted. We called King's Plumbing they came out & the problem has been resolved. Great service.

reviews.author: Logan Stelle
reviews.text: After some frustration with our HVAC company, it was a breath of fresh air working with Ron. He was professional, on time, and did the job well. With being new to the area, I’m glad I know I have our go-to plumber set up for any future issues with our house.

reviews.author: Josh Wheeler
reviews.text: Top notch service. I was even given a discount vs the quoted cost after the service was completed since the repair work ended up not being as significant as originally expected. I will definitely be using Kings Plumbing again when and if the need arises.

reviews.author: T Brandana
reviews.text: We had a major drain blockage rendering our bathrooms completely unusable. I called Kings Plumbing in the morning and Ron and Mitch were at my house completing the work by 1 PM. The gentlemen were professional, knowledgeable, and expediate. They cleared the blockage and checked all other drainage points. The price was fair and we now can use our bathrooms again!

reviews.author: Michelle Major
reviews.text: Kings Plumbing had to cut hole in ceiling to repair a leak. I was amazed at how clean the cut was and nothing on the floor. Employee was professional and showed concern for my problem. Kings Plumbing followed up to make sure everything was ok. They did an amazing job.

reviews.author: Catherine Reilly
reviews.text: Ron and Steve worked extremely hard to fix the problem with my sewer line. They are professional, prompt and very easy to work with. The cost was completely reasonable for the job they did. I would recommend Kings Plumbing to anyone looking for a top notch plumber!

reviews.author: Brian Wieland
reviews.text: Ron and Mitch were very professional and understanding in replacing the kitchen faucet, garbage disposal, and dishwasher at my mom's house. They quoted a very fair price and came promptly on the scheduled date. They were quick to diagnose and correct the issue from a prior contractor many years ago and very easy to work with. Would definitely recommend them to assist with your home plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Donicia Grimes
reviews.text: The owner and his wife are SUPER AMAZING. They have been my personal plumber for about 7 years and I've never had a complaint. He explains everything start to finish, all of his work is quality. Book him today.

reviews.author: Michelle Randol
reviews.text: We needed a plumber and selected Kings Plumbing based on other’s high reviews. They were excellent! From the initial phone call to the finished job, we received top notch customer service. Professional, knowledgeable, reliable and so pleasant to work with. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Tyler Hillman
reviews.text: Ok let me tell you, if you need any plumbing service, Ron is the man to go to! He and his team have taken such amazing care of me. I’ve had issues with my hot water heater, I’ve had pipes spring leaks, and I’ve had my toilet internals completely break. Every time he or one of his guys arrive so fast and handle the problem. I’ve never required any rework, the price is always affordable and fair. Seriously I would never go to another plumber. This is the place. Whatever you need, hit him up, you won’t be disappointed. 5/5 recommend.

reviews.author: Thea Nelson
reviews.text: Ron explain all that he was doing and come to find out it was wax that exploded (thought it was a good thing being in the sink and not all over the counter…wrong!) and gotten hard in the drain. He also fixed an issue with the pipe that was put on wrong. Thank you Ron. I recommend them for future jobs.

reviews.author: Justin Pulliam
reviews.text: Ron at King’s plumbing is amazing! He has helped us several times in some serious binds. He has done everything from unclogging a sewer stoppage, to replacing a water heater, to figuring out why it was raining from the ceiling from an old boiler system. He’s always been quick to respond and gets out to us quickly.

reviews.author: Renee Perry
reviews.text: Kings Plumbing technicians are the best. The technician came in and repaired my pipe in my wall in a timely fashion. He explained to me where the leak was and how he was going to repair it. He even clean up the area after he finished the repair. I'm a satisfied customer.. If you are looking for a Plumbing Company, don't look any further. You have found one. I do recommend Kings Plumbing Company.

reviews.author: Joe Collar
reviews.text: Mitch and Mike together did a great job repairing the leak underneath my kitchen sink. As we said in the military, bravo Zulu. Thank you so very much very professional and all aspects.

reviews.author: Matilda Cox
reviews.text: Kings installed a new sink in my kitchen. They did great work and were patient and diligent working out some problems with the pipes in my house. They were polite and professional and cleaned up completely before leaving. Many thanks.

reviews.author: Megan Greiner
reviews.text: Ron's response time was lightning fast. He is professional in manner and highly skilled and knowledgeable in his work. But more than that, Ron is kind. I have hired many contractors over the years and very few of them have been as nice to work with as Ron. I can say the exact same of his cohort Mitch, who is just as lovely as Ron. I can't speak highly enough of these guys. Kings Plumbing has my family's business for life.

reviews.author: Ana Rios
reviews.text: Kings plumbing was amazing with their same day help. The job was bigger than just a leak I expected and I was worried that we would have to reschedule for later in the week but they came back in the afternoon and got it done so much quicker than i expected. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dreaming Dreams
reviews.text: I was most impressed with King Plumber Company. Speaking with Ron, the owner of the company, to set up an appointment for my mother’s home plumbing matter, was effective and efficient; he was extremely personable and professional. Mitch, the licensed plumber who came out , was extremely kind. He addressed and greeted my mom with her proper title, Mrs. I really dislike a young person addressing a senior citizen by her/his friend name. In addition, Mitch was great. He discussed the matters we wanted fixed and only worked on those matters. He did not try to find other things to up sell. He arrived on time and called to inform he was on his way. The work product was outstanding. Most importantly I feel completely comfortable calling King Plumbers to fix matters for my mom going forward. They are officially our plumbers for life!! I highly recommend this company!!

reviews.author: Ya'ris Larenta
reviews.text: Tuesday, February 22nd, 2022 Kings Plumbing is an "Excellent" Company to utilize for ANY Plumbing issue. I had an Issue with my Home's Main Water Shut Off Valve. There was a ticking sound within the Walls inside the Hot Water Heater Closet; every time I washed clothes. I was so afraid that this sound occurred for a reason and would eventually result in damages beyond my Financial ability if I wasn't "Pro-Active" and get Professional assistance to quickly resolve this unknown issue. During my "Google Research" I located "Kings Plumbing." Ron was the Plumbing Specialist that returned my call. . . .in a "Timely/Professional" Manner. Upon arriving to my Home, Ron and his Co-Worker (Name escapes me); Introduced themselves; were Neat/Kind and Professional. Ron investigated my concern(s) and scheduled a time to return and attempt to rectify the issue(s). Ron made no Promises; but offered his Professional Opinion as to what the issue maybe (Loose Pipe within Wall and or a Shut Off Valve replacement. Ron assurred me that he'd do his BEST to resolve the issue. Ron arrived on the Scheduled Appt Date; on Time Professional, Courteous; and as at initial meeting; he wore a Mask. I reside in a "Condominium Association" and although I had to "Jump through Countless Hoops" to get the Association to assist with my Task of "Turning off Water" in my and related Bldgs for 4hrs. . .Ron was Patient/Professional and Understanding. Although there was no "loose Pipe," the Shut Off Valve; within the Hot Heater Closet Wall, the Main Shut Off Valve was damaged/cracked. Ron was Neat/Tidy while working and Clean up after himself although there wasn't much for him to clean up; remember as I stated. . .He was "Neat/Tidy." Ron replaced this Valve with no problem. The Valve replacement to my amazement stopped the ticking noise within the Walls. In addtion Ron; who worked alone that day; finished the Job in approximately 1hr of the allotted 4hr Window. . . . I would recommend this Company (King's Plumbing) to ANYONE; to start, My Family and Friends will be "First in Line!!!" GREAT JOB Ron!! Bridgette Y. Henson Condo Assoc./Owner

reviews.author: James Miskimen
reviews.text: Responded to my broken water pipe same day I made the call!! Ron and Mitch were professional throughout the whole process. Went above and beyond what was asked for him to do and even educated me on future emergencies. Could not have asked for a better job! They have my business for life!! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Stephen Miller
reviews.text: Kings is the best around. Always professional quality work, always a fair price and always excellent customer service. I’ve been using their services for years and don’t trust anyone else with plumbing work in my home. Top notch across the board.

reviews.author: Angel Renee Hall
reviews.text: Thank you KingsPlumbing VA for the excellent service. Water heater went out and Kings Plumbing got me up and running. Any plumbing problems I have, I always call them and receive excellent service. Call them for all your plumbing needs! Old homes or new homes, they can handle all your needs. Excellent and prompt service every time.

reviews.author: T Masterson
reviews.text: Ron is professional, punctual and does quality work at a great price. He is the only plumber that I am going to call from now on. Don’t hesitate to call him for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: FLMS
reviews.text: I have grown to trust Kings plumbing to handle our landlords plumbing needs. I can call easily & quickly get scheduled and assure tenants that they will be professional, timely & solution based. This is a great company & one our company can truly count on for superb work & value!

reviews.author: Michelle Yancey
reviews.text: Ron was professional and considerate. I never got the feeling like Kings was trying to rip me off with shady practices -- which I did get with the first company I called. Kings was honest and competent.

reviews.author: Mike Cary
reviews.text: I’ve used Kings on two different occasions. Both times they were easy to schedule and provided a 2 hour window for when they would arrive. They called prior to arrival and were quickly able to diagnose and fix the problem. Would use them again

reviews.author: Aaron
reviews.text: Ron and Mitch came out to fix/replace my outside hose connections. When they were done everything worked perfectly and they left both work sites totally clean for a very fair price. I would definitely have them help me with any future plumbing problem.

reviews.author: Emanuel
reviews.text: Kings showed up on time and diagnosed the problem right away. They gave a fair price and completed the work to my satisfaction. I would recommend them for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Ciera Killen
reviews.text: Kings Plumbing was great! They were so responsive when my water heater broke and actually made multiple trips out to my house on short notice when I called with concerns about it.

reviews.author: Fox F
reviews.text: Kings provided professional, prompt and knowledgeable service at a very reasonable price. The customer service was excellent, they went above and beyond to make sure the job was done correctly. If you are looking for a great plumbing service, look no further.

reviews.author: Venkat M
reviews.text: Ron and Mitch replaced some corroded valves at my place. Professional, friendly and focussed on the job. I highly appreciate that they either wore shoe covers or took off their shoes and wore masks inside. Good experience over all!

reviews.author: Lynn Kyle
reviews.text: They were able to do same day and price was just as quoted. Mitch arrived quickly and the work was done just as fast. He even taught me a few things that I can do in the future. Great company and service; they will be my go to for plumbing!

reviews.author: Boreal Bum
reviews.text: King’s came out and spent all of Thanksgiving day helping! Ron sacrificed an important day with his family to help us. I could not be more thankful. Ron was efficient, kind and worked tremendously hard. You cannot ask for better service.

reviews.author: Ron Miller
reviews.text: Excellent service, on time. Called me back very quickly, did exactly what they said they would when they would for exactly what they said it would cost. Ron was Extremely professional and did great work. Plan to use them again.

reviews.author: William Norris
reviews.text: Kings Plumbing installed my dishwasher the correct way and it’s working great. They’re very professional and laid back, plus easy to work with. Gonna be sticking with these guys from now on.

reviews.author: Deborah Rice
reviews.text: Mitch arrived on time and was professional and knowledgeable. He took his time to analyze my issues. I would definitely recommend them and use them again myself.

reviews.author: Laura Garner
reviews.text: Very professional, courteous, trustworthy. Showed up when they said they would. Gave a reasonable quote and ended up charging a bit less. Performed the work correctly and made a point to tell me to call them if any problems. Cleaned up work area before leaving. And really nice people.

reviews.author: Omiel Fairweather
reviews.text: Call them after hours for a leaky pipe, picked up after the 2nd ring and was at the property less than an hour and completed the repair. He also gave recommendations and suggestions that’s beneficial to me.

reviews.author: Jeff Harrison
reviews.text: I had a plumbing emergency. I called on Saturday morning around 10. They are supposed to be open 24 hours. They completely blew me off. Two calls and no response at all.

reviews.author: Denise McDaniel
reviews.text: Great company to work with!! They were quick to service us and kept me informed thru the entire job. I think they are an honest and professional company.

reviews.author: Sharon Delly
reviews.text: I’ve hired these plumbers twice and both times they did their work perfectly, on time, and cleaned up after themselves. They are friendly and polite as well. They are my go-to plumbers.

reviews.author: Jasmine
reviews.text: Amazing and exceptional service is exactly what I got. Ron and his team were on time, very knowledgeable, respectful to our home, and informative. I totally recommend, thanks!!!

reviews.author: Karla Villarreal
reviews.text: These guys worked fairly fast in replacing my garbage disposal. Got a brand new one works amazing. Highly recommend them they’re very professional.

reviews.author: Anna Peterson
reviews.text: Called these guys out to fix up some piping in our garage and remove an old sink, they showed up and did an all day professional job for a reasonable price. No regrets :)

reviews.author: Otis Lockett
reviews.text: Ron is excellent, responsive, professional and the best plumber I have ever had the pleasure of working with.

reviews.author: Jennifer Byrd
reviews.text: Kings plumbing did an AMAZING Job! Great communication and what the problem was and how they planned to fix.

reviews.author: Brian Taylor
reviews.text: Kings Plumbing has exceptional service and professionalism, I would recommend to anyone that needs any plumbing service!

reviews.author: Alexis Danchak
reviews.text: Ron was great. Explained everything, and fixed the repair thoroughly. Great company and highly recommend!

reviews.author: Charles Grudenich
